scope_note: Covers the statutory timetable for the Water Industry Commission for Scotland's reports and accounts, and what they must contain. Covers both the Commission's own constitutive legislation and the general public finance legislation that supplies the deadlines. Limited to legislation.

steps.title: Identify the Commission's own reporting and accounting duties
steps.detail: Retrieve the provisions of the Water Industry (Scotland) Act 2002 governing the Commission's annual report and its duty to prepare and send accounts, and note what each says about timing and content.

steps.title: Find where the deadlines actually sit
steps.detail: Where the Commission's own Act leaves timing to Ministers' direction, establish whether any general enactment imposes a backstop deadline on sending accounts to the Auditor General.

steps.title: Establish what the audited account must cover
steps.detail: Retrieve the provisions governing the auditor's report and the findings it must set out.

steps.title: Assemble the timeline
steps.detail: Put the duties in order from the end of the financial year, distinguishing fixed statutory deadlines from duties expressed as directions or as 'as soon as practicable'.
